page0.text:
"No, come back Saber...!"
I hear my voice, shouting at Saber before I even realize what I'm doing.

page1.text:
"Master...?"
Saber's steps slow, as if she heard my command.
But it's not enough! She won't get away in time...!

page2.text:
"It's dangerous, please get away...!"
"No! You're in danger! Just, come here...!"
I reach my hand out to Saber.

page3.text:
"I am...? Nn...!?"
She must have understood. Saber turns from Berserker and dashes away from the battlefield as fast as she can.

page4.text:
Just as Saber retreats...
...Archer fires his "arrow."

page5.text:
Saber jumps clear like sparks from a flame and Berserker rushes after her.
Archer's attack impacts between the two of them, at the center of the battlefield.
Up until now, his shots have done nothing.
Saber approaches, as if those arrows aren't even worth dodging.

page7.text:
""
The giant turns his back to us, attacking the incoming projectiles with furious intensity.

page9.text:
"...!"
I throw myself onto Saber and brace.
I must've gone deaf; I can't hear a thing.
But I can feel the vibrations in the air shaking my body and heat searing my skin.
The blast kicks up all kinds of debris, and I feel something stab into my back.

page10.text:
"...!"
I grit my teeth and brace myself.
The white flash of light must have lasted only an instant.
Somehow, I survived.

page11.text:
"Wha..."
Saber is clearly stunned by what she's seen.
...So am I.
I have no idea what happened.
I just know that Archer's attack wreathed the entire cemetery in flames.
At the explosion's center is a smoking crater.
That is the extent of his attack's destructive force.
In the heart of all that incredible destruction stands the giant. Still alive.

page12.text:
"...Berserker... He's unscathed even after taking a direct hit from a Rank A Noble Phantasm..."
The strength seems to have gone from Saber's voice.
Sparks flutter in the dark night air.
The giant stands, motionless, in the flames while all present look on in stunned silence.

page13.text:
The only sound to be heard is the soft crackling of the flames.
Just when I thought the flames might grow out of control...
"Huh...?"
A strange metal...something rolls toward me, clanging across the rubble-strewn ground.

page14.text:
"...A sword...?"
No, it's an arrow.
An arrow with a luxurious hilt and spiral blade.
It was a sword, I think. But it was used as an arrow.

page15.text:
...
I'm not sure why it captures my attention so much.
The arrows Berserker smashes aside disappear, as if simply melting away.
They fade without leaving a trace, like candle wax melting in flames.

page16.text:
That...
...makes me nauseous for no reason.

page17.text:
"...Shirou, those were..."
"...Archer's arrows. That's all I know."
I look up and see Archer in the distance.

page18.text:
"...!"
I can't possibly see that far.
I can't see it, but somehow...I do.
He's smiling.
He's smiling as if to say he hadn't just been aiming at Berserker.

page19.text:
"That bastard...!"
...I have a headache.
The chills running down my spine don't stop.
My spine is burning and I feel like throwing up, almost like the time I failed to create a Magic Circuit...

page20.text:
"...Hm, I've underestimated you, Rin. Your Archer's not bad."
The girl's cheerful voice drifts across the battlefield to us, but I'm not sure where from.

page21.text:
"Okay, come back, Berserker. I wanted to get the boring stuff over with first, but my plans have changed."
The dark shadow wavers.
The giant obeys the girl's voice and retreats through the flames.

page22.text:
"Oh, come on. You're going to run away after all this?"
"Yes, I've changed my mind. I don't need Saber, but I'm interested in your Archer. So, I'll let you live a bit longer."

page23.text:
The giant disappears.
The girl in white giggles.
"Bye-bye, then. Let's play again, big brother."
With those as her parting words, she disappears on the other side of the flames.

page24.text:
"..."
And just like that, she's gone.
I'm sure Tohsaka doesn't actually plan to go after her, despite what she's said.
Even I can tell that girl just let us go.
I can't imagine Tohsaka seeking out a fight like that. It'd be too reckless.

page25.text:
"Thank you, Master. Archer's Noble Phantasm would have hit me, had you not called out to me."
"O-oh, I'm..."
I try to say I was glad to help.

page26.text:
"Master...?"
...What's wrong with me?
I'm not badly hurt, but I don't feel well, and I think I'm starting to...

page27.text:
"...Emiya? You look really pale."
"Master...? Shirou...!"
...I fall to my knees.
Suddenly, my vision goes white.

page28.text:
"Pull yourself together...! What is going on...!?"
...I feel someone catch me as I fall.
But that feeling fades abruptly as most of my senses simply cut out.
